integrity: All 32768 labeled tournaments are partitioned into 56 explicit isomorphism orbits. Every claimed homotopy type is backed by a replayed acyclic discrete-Morse matching, and the five-vertex implementation reproduces the published Table 1 homology-rank distribution.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for tournaments on six vertices; no claim is made for larger tournament orders. Literature searches found no exact prior six-vertex census, but cannot exclude an obscure unindexed source.
title: Complete six-vertex tournament neighborhood-complex homotopy census
